_comment: The Ear's venue-logo registry. One entry per business we put on a page, so the same mark gets reused everywhere instead of being re-sourced each week. Every logo here came from the business's OWN site or official profile — never a stock/clip-art lookalike — and `source` records exactly where, so anyone can re-fetch or check it. `match` is how a nightlife.json `venue` string resolves to this entry: the venue field is compared case-insensitively against each string, and the LONGEST match wins (that's how 'Kern's Food Hall rooftop' still lands on kerns). Entries with no `logo` fall back to a typeset wordmark tile on the party page — the layout stays identical, so a missing file is never a hole.

_treatments.as-is: the venue's file, trimmed to its bounding box and scaled down; colors untouched
_treatments.ink-recolor: the mark was drawn light-on-dark (invisible on cream), so near-white strokes were repainted brand ink #171512 and the accent colors were left alone
_treatments.cropped: a sub-line irrelevant to us (another town, a tagline) was cropped off the bottom

angry-dumplings.sourceNote: the logo asset their own site loads (found in the site's JS bundle)
angry-dumplings.note: Not the same art as the Mon–Wed sponsor card — that's the Ear's own commissioned mascot engraving at /assets/spots/angry_dumpling_mascot.jpg. This is the restaurant's real logo.

fly-by-night.sourceNote: the horizontal wordmark the lounge's own site loads in its header (alt text 'Fly By Night (Logo)')

ijams-nature-center.name: Ijams Nature Center
ijams-nature-center.sourceNote: the horizontal 2023 lockup their own site header loads (674x191) — the bird-and-trees mark plus 'Ijams NATURE CENTER'; trimmed, colors untouched
ijams-nature-center.note: Every Ijams location resolves here: the River Landing, Mead's Quarry, the Nature Playscape, the Miller Education Building, the Homesite. The organization asked to be called Ijams Nature Center (2026-10-06); the alias list only matches text, it never writes it.

old-sevier-district.name: Old Sevier District
old-sevier-district.sourceNote: the header logo on oldsevierdistrict.org (alt 'Old Sevier District'): the blue contour-map circle with the yellow ring and the S arrow. The site serves it at 380x380; that is the largest copy they publish.
old-sevier-district.note: 'Old Sevier' is the district's merchant association, so the label 'Old Sevier' falls back here when a story names no venue of its own. 'Old Sevier Market' is longer and wins its own rows. Never add a bare 'Sevier' alias.

borderland-playhouse.name: Borderland Playhouse
borderland-playhouse.sourceNote: No mark to take, 2026-10-26: borderlandtees.com (GoDaddy builder) has no logo image at all — the header is text, the og:image is a photo strip of printed tees, the /playhouse page carries a stage photo, and the Facebook page picture is a photo of the press. The wordmark chip stands in until they publish one.

suttree-landing.name: Suttree Landing Park
suttree-landing.sourceNote: A City of Knoxville park with no mark of its own; the City's seal would say 'the City', not the park, and knoxvilletn.gov refuses non-browser fetches (403) anyway. Wordmark chip by design.

legacy-parks.sourceNote: the horizontal tree-and-wordmark lockup their site header loads (390x189, their own upload); trimmed, colors untouched
legacy-parks.note: Legacy Parks assembled the Urban Wilderness and owns Baker Creek Preserve, so trail-district rows with no narrower venue carry their mark. The Gateway Park is the City's; it resolves here through 'Urban Wilderness' because Legacy Parks is the name on the district.
